parsed.post: Discarding 0.996821. It was a regression compared to our previous best clean results (sub-0.98). My attempt to move to cleaner shards 0-9 while keeping the larger batch size 524288 likely resulted in fewer optimizer steps. Reverting to the best clean baseline and will follow the team's LR lowering trend (0.05 -> 0.04) with the smaller batch size 262144.
parsed.description: Testing MATRIX_LR=0.05 with TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 on clean shards 0-9 to align with team trends and recover from the batch size regression.
